decisions: Keep shared/capture/v1 as the single Capture owner and Universal Control V5 as the single global host.

shared_discoveries: A useful mobile recorder should expand while active; minimizing the active state creates unnecessary interaction cost.
Recoverable transcription needs a durable queue/lease model because browser-local Whisper may be interrupted by phone suspension, navigation, reload or device limits.
Continuity improves when AI research is saved as structured derived guidance and later consumed alongside human notes rather than trying to make old chats permanent authorities.
Automatic 'all unworked since last successful result' selection is simpler and safer than asking the user to manually identify the last processed note.
Product publication must verify actual GitHub Pages bytes, not just merge/build state; the final publisher now passed that live canary.
